business_problem: Crediclub recognized the need to enhance the operational management of its over 150 branches to maintain the consistency and quality of its processes.
solution_summary: Crediclub used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure AI Services to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as SharePoint, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. Crediclub used an AI auditing solution on Microsoft Azure to cut costs and boost efficiency.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure Cosmos DB
solution_components.role: Persists low-latency application data, conversation state, or operational records.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure Cosmos DB, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
